description: Application that replace .url windows files with an .html file with redirect to the original url
name: winurl2html

scripts.bun:fix: bun x oxfmt --write app.cjs && bun x oxlint --fix app.cjs
scripts.bun:ins: (bun --version || npm -g list bun || npm -g i bun) && bun install
scripts.bun:upd: bun x npm-check-updates -u && bun run bun:ins
scripts.test: snyk auth && snyk test && echo "Error: no test specified"
scripts.tool:bun:install: npm run tool:pnpm:install && (which bun >/dev/null 2>&1 || pnpm install -g bun) && bun upgrade --latest
